name: thumb_walkthrough_1
prompt: Vertical 9:16 YouTube Shorts thumbnail in the style of a bold Japanese tech-news magazine cover. ONE single continuous illustration filling the whole canvas edge to edge (no panels, no frames, no collage, no blurred edges); every area has a role, no empty space. LAYOUT (percent from the top): the title block fills the top half, from 4% to 48%, full width, three tiers with strong size contrast: tier 1 = a medium white word with a thick navy outline; tier 2 = the biggest, heaviest words, slightly tilted, in bright yellow or red with a thick dark outline and a deep 3D extrusion shadow, filling the full width; tier 3 = a small white text on a colored ribbon or banner. The girl (the attached character: same face, silver braided hair, blue jacket) is in the lower part, her head at about 50% and her body down to the bottom edge, taking about 40% of the image height, slightly right of center, holding or using the topic object described below; the topic object and the scene fill the rest of the lower part. Clean bold 2D anime style, vivid saturated colors, strong contrast, strong rim light. All Japanese text perfectly spelled exactly as given, no other text, no real brand logos, no watermark. No tiny decorative patterns or sparkles. Colors: dark navy with blue and cyan neon highlights. Scene: the girl walks confidently through a modern Japanese train station automatic ticket gate, smiling with a proud wink, both hands free, a generic smartphone peeking out of her jacket pocket with soft cyan radio waves rippling from it to the gate; the gate's flap is open and glows cyan; behind her a big diagonal two-color split background with bold speed lines toward the gate. No station names, no signs, no readable text except the title. Title: tier 1 'JR東日本 改札'; tier 2 'かざさず通れる' (the biggest text, yellow, filling the full width); tier 3 ribbon (blue) '2027年4月 14駅で体験'. No real company logos.
